note: The calibration fixtures of design 9.3 and where they live. 'file' is a stored fixture of this directory (the gate runner inlines the self-test at the marker); 'built' means the page is generated at test time from a synthetic model, because a stored built page would go stale with every viewer edit. 'expect' maps an innerWidth to the verdict and the sorted finding names. clipped-scene and sparse-scene live in scene/ (not in this directory itself: test_gate_smoke enumerates the *.html files here and wants each used by its own source); they were 'pending' placeholders until viewer-B (M6) added the 3D assertions (frames and nodes inside the canvas, occupancy floor), and are flipped to their real expectation.
